source: 1-loop massless cutbubble: cut={1,1} forces the AMFSystem master selection to fire the Cutkosky branch (top sector |var|=L+1, all cuts==1).  After the cut is cleared the eta-flow runs an ordinary 1-loop massive bubble; the final answer is Im[B0]*prefactor with prefactor = 2*(Pi^(2-eps)*(2*Pi)^(2*eps-4))^L*(-1)^(L+1) at L=1.  Designed to exercise the full SolveIntegrals -> AMFSystemSetupMaster -> Cutkosky pipeline end-to-end (the existing tt_cutkosky_probe never reaches Cutkosky for its boundary integrals).

cpp_sampled_status.result: Cutkosky path FIRED on top family (verified via DESOLVER_DEBUG_SCHEME stderr); eps=1/100 sample matches Mathematica reference
